d:
A beautiful celebration of sisterhood and family bonds! Hum Bahenon Ko Liye from the 1969 film Anjana is a memorable melody featuring Nazima and Rajendra Kumar. With the soulful voice of Lata Mangeshkar, this classic song brings back the charm and nostalgia of 60s Hindi cinema.
Hum Bahenon Ko Liye | Anjana (1969) | Nazima, Rajendra Kumar | Evergreen Lata Mangeshkar Song
Song: Hum Behanon Ke Liye
Movie: Anjana (1969)
Star Cast: Nazima, Rajendra Kumar, Nirupa Roy, Jr Mehmood
Singer: Lata Mangeshkar
Music Director: Laxmikant Pyarelal
Lyricist: Anand Bakshi
